metadata.description: Directional outpainting. Choose edges to expand. left, right, top, or center (uniform all sides). Only expanded areas are generated; an optional zoom-out pulls the frame back by the chosen amount.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.
height.title: Height

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.
width.title: Width

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

expand_bottom.description: Number of pixels to add as black margin on the bottom side (0-700).
expand_bottom.title: Expand Bottom

expand_left.description: Number of pixels to add as black margin on the left side (0-700).
expand_left.title: Expand Left

expand_right.description: Number of pixels to add as black margin on the right side (0-700).
expand_right.title: Expand Right

expand_top.description: Number of pixels to add as black margin on the top side (0-700).
expand_top.title: Expand Top

output_format.description: The format of the output image.
output_format.title: Output Format

prompt.description: Optional prompt to guide the outpainting. If provided, it will be appended to the base outpaint instruction. Example: 'with a beautiful sunset in the background'
prompt.title: Prompt

seed.description: The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time.
seed.title: Seed

sync_mode.description: If True, the function will wait for the image to be generated and uploaded before returning the response. If False, the function will return immediately and the image will be generated asynchronously.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

zoom_out_percentage.description: Percentage to zoom out the image. If set, the image will be scaled down by this percentage and black margins will be added to maintain original size. Example: 50 means the image will be 50% of original size with black margins filling the rest.
zoom_out_percentage.title: Zoom Out Percentage

info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/image-apps-v2/outpaint queue.
info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/image-apps-v2/outpaint

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).
